newsitem.title: INDIA: India's DCM Daewoo reports six-month net.
newsitem.headline: India's DCM Daewoo reports six-month net.

text.p: Indian car maker DCM Daewoo Motors Ltd recorded net profit of 281.5 million rupees in the first half of the 1996/97 (April-March) financial year, managing director S.G. Awasthi said on Monday.
The company did not release comparative figures for the first half of 1995/96.
For the entire 1995/96 year, DCM Daewoo reported net profit of 496 million rupees.
DCM Daewoo Motors Ltd is a joint venture between South Korea's Daewoo Motor, a unit of Daewoo Group, and India's DCM Ltd.

On August 14, the Cabinet Committee on Foreign Investment authorised Daewoo Motor to raise its stake to 75 percent from 51 percent, and allowed DCM to lower its stake to 3.22 percent from 27.22 percent.
